title: Why do ants walk in a line?

sections.text: Have you ever seen ants walking one behind another? Why do they do that?
Ants leave a special smell on the ground called a scent trail. Other ants follow this smell to find food!

items: Ants can carry things 50 times their own weight!
There are over 10,000 kinds of ants in the world.
Ants talk to each other using smells, not words.

sections.text: Ants teach us that working together and helping each other makes hard things easy.

reflection_question: What would you do if you could talk to ants?
real_world_mission: Go outside and find a line of ants. Watch where they are going!
